2026 Trade Deadline

Every team has until August 3 at 6:00 PM ET to make a trade before rosters lock in for the stretch run. Contenders look to add; rebuilding teams look to sell rentals and pending free agents for prospects. Nothing here is confirmed until a team announces it — rumors and reporting are labeled as such, not completed trades.

Speculation is part of the deadline — it always is — but this page only pulls from outlets with named-reporter bylines and a track record of accurate sourcing. The "Reporters to Watch" list links straight to the insiders who break most of the real news, since the fastest-moving rumors often land on social media before any outlet publishes.
